description: This file defines a mock actor class 'MockProxyActor' for testing purposes within an Akka-based messaging system. It includes methods to create actor instances and handle message forwarding, with an inner class 'MockInnerActor' that manages message reception and forwarding.

classes.name: MockProxyActor
classes.description: A mock actor class that forwards all messages to the last ActorRef it received, used for testing interactions in the messaging system.

classes.name: MockInnerActor
classes.description: An inner class within MockProxyActor that manages message reception and forwarding, maintaining a reference to a recipient ActorRef.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new MockProxyActor instance within the provided ActorSystem with the name 'connectivityRoot'.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes the actor by creating a 'connectivityProxyActor' child within the actor context.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic for the MockProxyActor (although it currently handles no messages).

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling logic for the MockInnerActor, setting behavior for ActorRef messages and any other messages.
